description: Decide which model fits a need — returns the modelId to use with generate_image. Cheapest, fastest, or highest quality; for images, video, or utility tools (upscale, background removal); with or without a source image. Pass private:true to restrict to the private AI model line (i2v models).

hasSourceImage.description: True when a source image drives the job (forces i2i/i2v/tool)

private.description: True to consider only the private AI model line

title: Pick a model for a task
